hunks.baseline: I was about to say so when Hyuk Mujin, having turned his back to the county magistrate, silently mouthed at me.
hunks.sol: I was about to say so when Hyuk Mujin turned his back to the county magistrate and silently mouthed at me.

hunks.baseline: *You absolutely have to go?*
hunks.sol: *You have to go.*

hunks.sol: “Ha-ha, spoken like a true citizen of a Great Nation. The City Lord will be delighted to hear it.”

hunks.sol: Only then did the county magistrate’s expression soften into a satisfied smile. He turned to leave.

hunks.baseline: “I think you have something to tell me, don’t you?”
hunks.sol: “I think you have something to tell me. Don’t you?”

hunks.baseline: We proceeded farther into the village and reached our destination. A little errand boy shot out like a bullet and bowed at the waist.
hunks.sol: We continued farther into the village until we reached our destination. A young errand boy shot out like a bullet and bowed at the waist.

hunks.baseline: He was startled once by the fifty mounted riders and the intimidating presence of the escort, then a second time when he recognized Hyuk Mujin and me.
hunks.sol: The fifty mounted riders and the escort force’s intimidating presence startled him once. Recognizing Hyuk Mujin and me startled him a second time.

hunks.baseline: He was the errand boy from the Phoenix Inn. I had seen him a few days ago.
hunks.sol: He was the errand boy from the Phoenix Inn, whom I’d met a few days ago.

hunks.baseline: “The private annex is fifty nyang of silver for one night. That’s right, isn’t it?”
hunks.sol: “The private annex is fifty silver nyang a night. Right?”

hunks.baseline: “Hey, you little brat. Are you pointing at a guest as lofty as the heavens?”
hunks.sol: “Why, you little brat. How dare you point at a guest as lofty as the heavens?”

hunks.baseline: After scolding the boy in a stern voice, Hyuk Mujin tossed him a heavy money pouch.
hunks.sol: After sternly scolding the boy, Hyuk Mujin tossed him a heavy money pouch.

hunks.baseline: The little boy glanced nervously between us, then inhaled sharply when he saw the pouch packed with silver.
hunks.sol: The boy glanced nervously between us, then sucked in a breath when he saw the pouch packed with silver.

hunks.baseline: “From this moment on, the Phoenix Inn is under the control of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.”
hunks.sol: “From this moment on, the Jin Family of Taiyuan is taking over the Phoenix Inn.”

hunks.baseline: “…Are you some kind of two-knife gangster?”
hunks.sol: “…What are you, some knife-wielding thug?”

hunks.baseline: The three zombies climbed out of the carriage and began gulping down the broth the moment the food arrived.
hunks.sol: The three zombies climbed out of the carriage and began gulping down broth the moment the food arrived.

hunks.baseline: It was understandable, considering they had spent three days drinking to excess without taking a single day off. No—if they hadn’t practiced martial arts, they might have died of alcohol poisoning on the first day.
hunks.sol: It was understandable. They had spent three straight days drinking themselves senseless. If they hadn’t practiced martial arts, they might have died of alcohol poisoning on the first day.

hunks.baseline: The instant Jin Wikyung leaned back in his chair after finishing his hangover cure, Wipeng’s nagging flew at him.
hunks.sol: The instant Jin Wikyung leaned back in his chair after curing his hangover, Wipeng began nagging him.

hunks.baseline: “Even so, what will your subordinates think if you keep showing them this side of yourself?”
hunks.sol: “Even so, what will your subordinates think if you keep letting them see you like this?”

hunks.baseline: With a single sentence, Jin Wikyung silenced Wipeng. Then he turned to me.
hunks.sol: That single sentence silenced Wipeng. Jin Wikyung then turned to me.

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know why, but he seemed interested in me. I was planning to reject it, but some thoughtless idiot accepted it without hesitation.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know why, but he seemed interested in me. I was going to refuse, but some thoughtless idiot jumped at the invitation.”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin, who had been sitting in the corner of the table and nervously watching our expressions, answered in a tiny voice.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin, who had been huddled at the corner of the table and watching everyone’s expressions, answered in a voice barely louder than a mouse’s squeak.

hunks.baseline: “Ah, I see. You’re the fellow who’s supposed to be our youngest brother’s right-hand man. The one who was in the Gatekeeper Pavilion until recently. Your name was… Hyuk Mujin, wasn’t it?”
hunks.sol: “Ah, I see. You’re the fellow they call our youngest brother’s right-hand man. The one who served at the Gate Guard Pavilion until recently. Your name was… Hyuk Mujin, wasn’t it?”

hunks.baseline: Compared to the modern world, the Jin Family of Taiyuan was a conglomerate, while Jin Wikyung was the chairman’s eldest son and the actual head of the company.
hunks.sol: Compared to the modern world, the Jin Family of Taiyuan was a conglomerate, while Jin Wikyung was the chairman’s eldest son and the company’s de facto head.

hunks.baseline: Assistant Manager Hyuk, who had spent all his time being bullied under a foul-tempered boss, answered in a deeply moved voice.
hunks.sol: Assistant Manager Hyuk, who had spent every day getting bullied by his foul-tempered boss, answered in a deeply moved voice.

hunks.baseline: “I should be thanking you. Our youngest brother still has some rough edges, so continue helping him as you did today.”
hunks.sol: “I should be thanking you. Our youngest brother still has some rough edges, so keep helping him as you did today.”

hunks.baseline: “Really? From what I’ve experienced so far, he doesn’t seem to have much to do with the Murim.”
hunks.sol: “Really? From what I’ve seen so far, the government doesn’t seem to have much to do with the Murim.”

hunks.sol: I had learned about the Murim through novels. The common conventions of martial-arts fiction weren’t all that different from how things worked here.

hunks.sol: “We are martial artists, but it is the Emperor who rules the world. Among the people, the authority of the Son of Heaven is absolute. The City Lords govern their respective provinces under the Emperor’s command, so they wield considerable power and authority.”

hunks.sol: So the government and the Murim were like a crocodile and a plover.

hunks.sol: After thinking for a moment, I voiced the question that had been nagging at me.

hunks.baseline: “Then why do you sit back and do nothing when mounted bandits run wild or large-scale battles break out between sects? I can understand staying out of the last war because it was a matter between martial artists, but the mounted bandits are different, aren’t they?”
hunks.sol: “Then why does the government sit back and do nothing when mounted bandits run wild or large-scale battles break out between sects? I can understand staying out of the last war because it was a matter between martial artists, but the mounted bandits are different, aren’t they?”

hunks.sol: Lee Cheonbaek had massacred everyone at the Sakju Branch and even committed the insane act of killing children, but the victims had belonged to the Jin Family of Taiyuan.

hunks.baseline: Strictly speaking, they could be considered people who had been sacrificed to the gratitude and grudges between Murim sects.
hunks.sol: Strictly speaking, they had been casualties of the gratitude and grudges between Murim sects.

hunks.sol: But mounted bandits killed indiscriminately and burned everything in their path.

hunks.sol: *To mounted bandits, commoners are easy prey.*

hunks.sol: Weak before the strong and strong before the weak. That was what mounted bandits were.

hunks.sol: The point was, I had encountered dozens of them on the way to the Mount Heng Sword Sect, yet I hadn’t seen a single government soldier.

hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung trailed off. Jin Mukyung, who had been silently shoveling down his food until then, spoke without looking up.

hunks.baseline: “Because the City Lord is incompetent. No, in this case, is the Emperor incompetent?”
hunks.sol: “Because the City Lord is incompetent. No, in this case, perhaps the Emperor is the incompetent one.”

hunks.baseline: The moment he finished speaking, Hyuk Mujin had a fit, while Jin Wikyung and Wipeng deliberately hardened their expressions.
hunks.sol: The moment he finished speaking, Hyuk Mujin nearly had a seizure, while Jin Wikyung and Wipeng deliberately hardened their expressions.

hunks.baseline: “Hey, Mukyung.”
hunks.sol: “Now, Mukyung.”

hunks.baseline: “It’s just us here. No one can overhear us. And I haven’t said anything untrue.”
hunks.sol: “It’s just us here. No one can overhear us. Besides, I didn’t say anything untrue.”

hunks.baseline: I asked Jin Mukyung, who reluctantly nodded.
hunks.sol: I turned to Jin Mukyung, who reluctantly nodded.

hunks.baseline: “Do you not know the meaning of the word incompetent?”
hunks.sol: “Do you not know what the word *incompetent* means?”

hunks.baseline: “Treason gets at least three clans punished. Congratulations, little brother.”
hunks.sol: “Treason means punishment for at least three generations of one’s family. Congratulations, little brother.”

hunks.baseline: *This guy Jin Mukyung has gotten pretty good with words.*
hunks.sol: *This bastard Jin Mukyung was getting pretty good at talking back.*

hunks.baseline: “Do you know who the City Lord is right now?”
hunks.sol: “Do you know who the current City Lord is?”

hunks.baseline: “…If you don’t know, just say you don’t know.”
hunks.sol: “…If you don’t know, just say so.”

hunks.baseline: “The current City Lord of Shanxi has the surname Zhu.”
hunks.sol: “The current City Lord of Shanxi bears the surname Zhu.”

hunks.baseline: “What do you mean, ‘so’? He’s a member of the imperial family. The imperial family!”
hunks.sol: “What do you mean, *so*? He’s a member of the imperial family. The imperial family!”

hunks.baseline: It seemed to be a Zhu dynasty. I had been branded an ignorant fool who didn’t even know the Emperor’s surname in the space of a moment.
hunks.sol: Apparently, this was a Zhu dynasty. In the span of a moment, I had been branded an ignorant fool who didn’t even know the Emperor’s surname.

hunks.baseline: Still, it wasn’t as if this sort of thing had only happened once or twice. I wasn’t even embarrassed anymore.
hunks.sol: Still, it wasn’t as if this had only happened once or twice. I wasn’t even embarrassed anymore.

hunks.baseline: “Fine, I get it. Continue.”
hunks.sol: “Fine, I get it. Keep going.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Mukyung sighed deeply and went on.
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung let out a deep sigh and continued.

hunks.baseline: “The current City Lord is the Emperor’s youngest brother. His imperial title is a Prince. He is a direct member of the imperial family, so he stands on a different level from the other City Lords. He is someone whose invitation we must accept, even if only to preserve his dignity.”
hunks.sol: “The current City Lord is the Emperor’s youngest brother, and his imperial title is Prince. As a direct member of the imperial family, he stands far above the other City Lords. He’s someone whose invitation we must accept, even if we have to force ourselves, if only to preserve his dignity.”

hunks.baseline: He really was on a different level. Not just an ordinary City Lord, but the Emperor’s brother. An actual king, no less.
hunks.sol: He really was on another level. He wasn’t just some ordinary City Lord, but the Emperor’s brother. An actual prince.

hunks.baseline: Born the son of the Son of Heaven and then becoming the younger brother of the Son of Heaven, he wasn’t merely born with a silver spoon in his mouth. He had a vibranium spoon.
hunks.sol: Born the son of the Son of Heaven and then becoming the younger brother of the Son of Heaven, he hadn’t merely been born with a silver spoon in his mouth. His spoon was made of vibranium.

hunks.baseline: The North Korean nuclear spoon of the modern world—and then some.
hunks.sol: He was the modern North Korean nuclear spoon—and then some.

hunks.baseline: “Then how can someone who’s practically a king be so incompetent? If he writes his brother a single letter, he could get all the support he needs from above. Are they on bad terms?”
hunks.sol: “Then how can someone who’s practically royalty be so incompetent? One letter to his brother should get him all the support he needs from above. Are they on bad terms?”

hunks.baseline: “Who knows? I don’t know the details of that family’s circumstances, but they don’t seem particularly close. There are rumors that the current Emperor assassinated the Crown Prince, the brother immediately older than him, before ascending the throne.”
hunks.sol: “Who knows? I don’t know the details of that family’s affairs, but I doubt they’re particularly close. There are rumors that the current Emperor assassinated the Crown Prince, his immediately older brother, before ascending the throne.”

hunks.baseline: “People kill over a single dumpling. Imagine what they’d do for the imperial throne.”
hunks.sol: “People kill each other over a single dumpling. Imagine what they’d do for the imperial throne.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung and Wipeng’s mouths fell open, while Hyuk Mujin had another fit.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung and Wipeng’s mouths fell open, while Hyuk Mujin nearly had another seizure.

hunks.baseline: “Judge, I didn’t hear anything. I truly know nothing. In fact, I haven’t been able to hear for a long time…”
hunks.sol: “Your Honor, I heard nothing. I truly know nothing. In fact, I’ve been deaf for years…”

hunks.baseline: “Does he not receive support because he’s on bad terms with the Emperor? Or is he simply lost in alcohol and women?”
hunks.sol: “Does he not get any support because he’s on bad terms with the Emperor? Or is he simply lost in wine and women?”

hunks.baseline: “Alcohol? Women?”
hunks.sol: “Wine? Women?”

hunks.baseline: Jin Mukyung let out another quiet laugh.
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung gave another short laugh.

hunks.baseline: “He’s only ten years old. It’s too early for him to lose himself in wine and women.”
hunks.sol: “He’s only ten years old. That’s a bit young to lose himself in wine and women.”

hunks.baseline: “What, ten? You mean a ten-year-old is the City Lord?”
hunks.sol: “What? Ten? You mean a ten-year-old is the City Lord?”

hunks.baseline: “He’s a direct member of the imperial family. He has the bloodline to become more than a City Lord.”
hunks.sol: “He’s a direct member of the imperial family. With his bloodline, he could become far more than a City Lord.”

hunks.baseline: I had thought it was ridiculous for a middle-aged man to act so childish, but now that I knew he was a ten-year-old boy, it finally made sense.
hunks.sol: I had thought it was ridiculous for a grown man to act so childish, but now that I knew he was a ten-year-old boy, it finally made sense.

hunks.baseline: Wasn’t that the age when you’d sulk at a falling leaf?
hunks.sol: Wasn’t that the age when even a falling leaf could make you sulk?

hunks.baseline: “The more amusing fact is that he was first appointed City Lord five years ago.”
hunks.sol: “What’s even more amusing is that he was first appointed City Lord five years ago.”

hunks.baseline: What could a five-year-old possibly know? I could roughly guess why the public order in Shanxi Province had become such a mess. I also understood why Jin Mukyung had said that the Emperor, rather than the City Lord, was more incompetent.
hunks.sol: What could a five-year-old possibly know? I could roughly guess why public order in Shanxi Province had become such a mess. I also understood why Jin Mukyung had said the Emperor, rather than the City Lord, was the incompetent one.

hunks.baseline: This wasn’t some neighborhood convenience store. They had put a child in a position that demanded ability and responsibility. There was no way things could run properly.
hunks.sol: This wasn’t some neighborhood corner store. They had put a child in a position demanding both ability and responsibility. There was no way anything could run properly.

hunks.baseline: The answer I received was unexpected.
hunks.sol: His answer was unexpected.

hunks.baseline: Well, if I was the rising super rookie of the moment, Jin Mukyung was already an established Peak master. It made sense that he would have been invited before me.
hunks.sol: Well, if I was the hot new rookie of the moment, Jin Mukyung was already an established Peak master. It made sense that he would have been invited before me.
